source.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
source.scope: Pass 1：摘要、引言、模型结构图与结论

words.context: 论文用它强调结果相较此前水平有明显提升。
words.example: The network performed considerably better than previous approaches.

words.context: 作者采用 dropout 来缓解全连接层的过拟合。
words.example: The authors employ dropout to reduce overfitting.

words.context: 作者还提交了该模型的一个变体参加比赛。
words.example: A variant of the model was entered in the competition.

words.context: 现实场景中的物体会呈现很大的差异。
words.example: Objects in realistic settings exhibit substantial variation.

words.context: 它描述同一类别物体在现实图像中的多样变化。
words.example: The dataset captures the natural variability within each class.

words.context: 标签保持变换可以扩充较小的训练数据集。
words.example: Label-preserving transformations augment the training set.

words.context: 论文指出小型图像数据集存在明显不足。
words.example: Limited diversity is a major shortcoming of small datasets.

words.context: 目标识别任务具有极高的复杂度。
words.example: Recognizing objects in natural images is an immense challenge.

words.context: CNN 构成了适合图像识别的一类模型。
words.example: Convolutional networks constitute a powerful class of models.

words.context: 模型中的先验知识用来弥补有限数据未覆盖的信息。
words.example: Prior knowledge can compensate for information absent from the data.

words.context: 高效 GPU 实现让大型 CNN 的训练成为可能。
words.example: Efficient GPU code facilitates the training of large networks.

words.context: 移除任一卷积层都会导致较差的性能。
words.example: Removing a convolutional layer produced inferior performance.
